contract.paths: first readable regular file, then readable alternatives after an I/O failure
contract.rotation: Linux device/inode replacement or truncation resets the offset

report.metadata: SSH brute force: <count> failed attempts in <Java duration>. Sample: <bounded source line>

configuration.precedence: new key wins independently for each field

behavior_differences.scope: cleanup runs while a report has cleared the failure queue but its cooldown is still active
behavior_differences.oracle_behavior: Java cleanup removes an empty failure queue and its lastReported entry before the cooldown expires, so two new failures can report again early
behavior_differences.candidate_behavior: Rust keeps last_report through the configured cooldown and only removes it after twice the cooldown; cleanup also honors cleanup-interval
behavior_differences.reason: Replicating the early-removal path would defeat the configured brute-force report cooldown

behavior_differences.scope: more than 4096 unique reported IPs in one summary period or more than the bounded sample state
behavior_differences.oracle_behavior: Java hourly summary maps, username set, and retained sample state are not hard bounded
behavior_differences.candidate_behavior: Rust retains at most 4096 IP detail rows, 10 usernames, and 3 bounded samples, and emits an omitted-data marker
behavior_differences.reason: Prevent log amplification and attacker-controlled hourly memory growth

behavior_differences.scope: adversarial input beyond the explicit parser and scheduling budgets
behavior_differences.oracle_behavior: Java reads an unbounded batch of newly appended lines and keeps unbounded per-IP failure timestamps
behavior_differences.candidate_behavior: Rust defers bytes/events beyond each scan budget, drops an unterminated line over 64 KiB, and caps each IP queue at 4096 timestamps
behavior_differences.reason: Keep file I/O, parser state, CPU work, and persistence admission bounded without dropping in-budget complete lines

verification.command: python blackbox/tools/run_smtp_rbl.py -m oracle && python blackbox/tools/run_smtp_rbl.py -m candidate
